title: iria castanea
intro: Iria castanea, commonly known as Castanea, is a plant species within the Fagaceae family, native to the mountainous regions of China and other parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Iria castanea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Iria castanea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective effects.
